analyst_view.overall: Leaders PSV (29 pts from 13) host Go Ahead Eagles (9th, 17 pts) four days after a 5-1 defeat at Real Madrid, where they led at half-time through an Ivan Perisic penalty before collapsing. Perisic was taken off at half-time and one injury list rates him a doubt (25%); that is not yet confirmed elsewhere. PSV are also without Mauro Junior, Schouten, Plea, Ouaissa and Nagalo, all in the numbers. Go Ahead lost their last game 1-0 at home to Fortuna Sittard, are weaker away, have Saathof and Marsman out and Dean James, Linthorst and Margaret as doubts, and lean on Sören Tengstedt (nine goals). Referee Dennis Higler's low card average is already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 4.3 goals, mostly from PSV (3.1), already trimmed for Mauro Junior and Plea. I lean slightly lower (-3%, about 4.2) because one injury list has Perisic, PSV's main creator and penalty taker, as a doubt after he came off at half-time in Madrid, and the numbers do not know that. It is a mild lean because only one source reports it.

corners.text: The numbers say 11.1 corners, with PSV taking about 7 as they pin opponents back. Go Ahead are weaker away and may be without wide players James and Margaret, which fits the deep approach the numbers already expect. I stay at 11.1.

cards.text: The numbers say 2.4 cards, already lowered by about 12% for Dennis Higler, who has shown 2.1 cards a game. Go Ahead have been booked rarely lately and PSV seldom need fouls at home, so I stay at 2.4.

shots.text: The numbers say 34.1 shots, with PSV at 24.5. I trim slightly to about 33.1: PSV come off a draining night at the Bernabeu, where they were overrun in the second half, and the numbers do not count that congestion. It is a mild lean, as PSV dominate at home and their league lead keeps Bosz from resting many.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.9 shots on target. I trim slightly (-3%, about 11.5) for the same reasons as goals and shots: Perisic may miss out (one report) and PSV may be tired after Madrid. Go Ahead's own attack depends on Tengstedt and has gone quiet in recent away games, which the numbers already count.
